sourceChecks.note: The official product page independently validates the blue MR Classic model, 36 x 9.9 x 44 mm geometry, 20 mm lug width, 316L steel case, transparent caseback, high-domed hesalite, CAL5000a automatic micro-rotor movement, 42-hour reserve, and 30 m water resistance. A 2026-08-30 recheck of its embedded public Storefront payload resolves product 6584366596167 and exact Stitched Lion variant 39484285321287 as available for sale at EUR 545 with a 2026-08-31 fulfillment date.

Baltic's official regional collection page displays MR Classic Blue from EUR 545. The product's embedded variant payload now independently establishes that EUR 545 is also the exact Stitched Lion variant price rather than relying on the family starting label alone.

Baltic's exact Stitched Lion accessory page identifies a 20 mm calf-leather strap with stainless-steel pin buckle, universal Baltic compatibility, and a quick-release spring-bar fastening system interchangeable without tools. The watch's primary variant payload explicitly selects this named strap.

Baltic's Turkish representative and authorized dealer independently maps MR Classic Blue with Stitched Lion to product code MR01BLUS35 and describes the included 20 mm quick-release leather strap. Its sold-out Turkish offer is not mixed into the reviewed manufacturer-direct EUR snapshot.

The hands-on article examines a blue MR01 production-family sample and lists lume as N/A and no date window, but uses the earlier Hangzhou ELA05MN movement and does not identify the current MR01BLUS35 Stitched Lion configuration. It cannot establish configured weight, exact accuracy, or variant-specific lume/date facts.

The article lists Lume: None for a black gold-PVD MR01 sibling. The different case and dial configuration is not directly applicable evidence for the selected blue MR01BLUS35 variant, so no lume value is promoted.

The exact retailer page independently identifies MR01BLUS35, the Stitched Lion strap, 36 mm steel case, Hangzhou CAL5000a, hesalite, and 30 m resistance. It publishes no configured weight, numerical accuracy bound, lume statement, or date status, so none of the four remaining M1 fields is promoted.
